# Descriptions
@@ 1
An animal will arrive bearing some form of nourishment: berries, nuts, or
tubers (vegetable matter). The animal will drop the food and return to the
wilderness.
@@ 2
A heavily-furred animal will arrive and lie down near the caster. The animal
will allow the caster (and only the caster) to lie down next to it.
@@ 3
An animal who knows the path to a specific location will arrive. The animal
will guide the caster to that location as long as he concentrates on the
desired location.
@@ 4
A suitable large animal that is capable of inflicting at least Medium animal
attacks will arrive. This animal will attempt to protect the caster from
hostile attacks. If the caster leaves the general area in which the spell was
cast, the animal will not travel with him (i.e., it will leave).
@@ 5
A large animal will arrive and serve as a mount for the caster.
@@ 6
As Summon Nourishment, except animal brings a recently killed prey (some form
of meat).
@@ 7
An animal with a specified heightened sense will arrive. For the duration of
the spell, the animal will “perceive” for the caster. The caster can
concentrate to have the animal communicate what he has been perceiving.
@@ 9
A “group” of animals will arrive and stay near the area where the spell was
cast. For the purposes of this spell, the animals summoned must normally
travel in groups (e.g., wolves, deer, birds, etc.).
@@ 10
The caster can use any lower level spells on this list, except that one animal
per level will be summoned.
@@ 12
This spell produces ground covering of grasses and small plants of other
varieties. The plants must already exist in the area of effect. This spell
simply allows them to multiply and grow faster (coverage takes 20+d100 hours).
@@ 13
Caster prayers to his deity for fog. The chance that the prayer is answered is
2% per level of the caster. See note #6 below.
@@ 14
As Fog Prayer, except generates a light rain.
@@ 15
As Spread Plants I, except will also spread saplings and small trees.
@@ 16
As Fog Prayer, except will generate a heavy thunderstorm.
@@ 17
As Fog Prayer, except generates a hail storm.
@@ 19
As Fog Prayer, except will generate a lightning storm.
@@ 20
As Fog Prayer, except will generate weather that results in a tornado.
@@ 25
As Fog Prayer, except will ensure clear weather.
@@ 30
As Fog Prayer, except caster’s deity will grant whatever weather would be most
beneficial to the caster’s current goal.
@@ 50
As any of the Prayer spells on this list, except chance of getting the effect
is 95%.
